description: Open mathematical problem research combining frontier AI reasoning, exact computational certificates, and Lean 4 formal verification across mathematical fields.

problems.title: Tutte's 3-Flow Conjecture
highlights: Proved every 4-edge-connected (and odd-5-edge-connected) multigraph with at most 16 odd-degree vertices admits a nowhere-zero integer 3-flow (every counterexample needs >= 18 odd vertices).
Proved unrestricted b <= 12 nonroot degree-5 pinned theorem for arbitrary graph order via two independent C++17 enumerators certifying 139.2M (order 13) and 105.6B (order 15) isomorphism classes.
Kernel-verified end-to-end Lean 4 proof of the exact 2^(r-1) missing-boundary formula and universal one-edge Z3-connectivity repair for arbitrary r-block 3-matching trees (MatchingTree.lean).
Proved explicit 88-vertex unweighted obstruction to coupled Laplacian electrical rounding and pinned 5-cube obstruction to unsigned thin-tree cut bounds.

problems.title: TxGraffiti Conjecture 3 (Regular Independent Domination vs. Matching Saturation)
highlights: Complete zero-sorry Lean 4 kernel disproof (TxGraffiti3.not_TxGraffitiConjecture3) directly against the frozen google-deepmind/formal-conjectures statement via a 277-row decide +kernel certificate.
Reduced the smallest known connected cubic counterexample from prior public 50-vertex and 48-vertex graphs down to 42 vertices (4 non-isomorphic order-42 cubic graphs with i(G) = 14 > 13 = mu*(G)).
Constructed connected counterexamples in every degree 3t (t >= 1) via independent-set vertex blowups.
Exhaustively certified 50,724,108 positive-regular graphs through order 14 plus 12,967,515 connected 3/4/5-regular graphs, pinning 15 <= n_min <= 42 and cubic 22 <= n_min^(3) <= 42.

problems.title: Fourier Entropy-Influence (FEI) Conjecture
highlights: Beat the published teorth/optimizationproblems #71a world record with a standalone stdlib-only exact rational certificate: H(f)/I(f) > 6.521851167347822949109657013506222645.

Kernel-verified end-to-end Lean 4 equivalence between the frozen FEI conjecture and uniform bounds on fixed-order dyadic midpoint crossings R_fixed(f) and dyadic grid energy G(f) (GridEquivalence.lean).

Proved equivalence of FEI with fixed-error real matrix rank log2(r_{1/4}(M)) <= K(I_X + I_Y), plus a non-XOR CHSH selector lift achieving S(M)/(I_X+I_Y) > 3.76092558367391147455 (+0.5 bit/influence above XOR).

Proved sharp rank-2 constant 2 and explicit rank-5 violation (> 2.0024983293), plus uniform P_2/I bounds for linearly recoded block-symmetric, quadratic lookup (P_2 < 60I), and block-permutation classes.

problems.title: Fonollosa's Minimum Modulus Conjecture

world_record.metric: Unconditional cyclic lower bound on valid modulus N
world_record.new_record: N >= (11/16) * 2^n for all n >= 3 (kernel-proved in Lean 4); n=10 narrowed to 724 <= N <= 1012

highlights: Kernel-proved new world-record unconditional cyclic lower bound N >= (11/16) * 2^n (0.6875 * 2^n) for all n >= 3 in Lean 4 (RankSlots.cyclic_eleven_sixteenths), beating Sitjar's published bound for every n >= 6 via 8-label packing and an unequal-size Bollobas set-pair inequality (SetPairCounting.lean), and proved 11/16 is the exact ceiling of the signature-square relaxation.
Kernel-proved conditional 3/4 bound N >= (3/4) * 2^n whenever a valid set contains a nondegenerate affine copy of {0, 1, 3} (three_quarters_of_triple).
Kernel-proved exact binary-core rigidity N >= 2^n - 2^(floor(log2 n)) and forced last residue for all n >= 6 with an (n-1)-element unit-affine binary core (minModulus_le_of_affine_binary_core).

Narrowed the first open case n = 10 to 724 <= N <= 1012: raised continuous floor to 724 via exact exchange profiles and exhaustively excluded all three top boundary moduli N = 1015, 1014, 1013 via dual C++17 verifiers (562.7M six-point prefixes and 680.1M target graphs at 1015).

problems.title: Catch-Up Game Even-Sum Draw Conjecture

world_record.metric: Exact Catch-Up prefix draw verification and density census
world_record.new_record: Exact draw verified through N = 48 (all openings draw for 12 <= N <= 44); 68,199,392 density boards verified through max <= 32

highlights: Extended exact prefix draw verification from N <= 34 to N = 48 via dual independent C++17 solvers + Lean opening reversal, confirming every opening draws for all eligible 12 <= N <= 44.

Kernel-proved universal infinite-family draw theorems in Lean 4: critical high intervals ([a, a+2n-1], n) for all a >= 2n-1 (1 <= n <= 8 in Lean, 1 <= n <= 16 exact), all nine adjacent deletions from [a, a+9] for every a >= 1, arbitrary bank embeddings B u {W+1, W+2, W+3}, and exact upper minimum-pick ray values.

Proved 6 tokens are necessary and sufficient for a first-player loss on distinct positive integers (Lean witness {4,5,6,7,12,14} + 3,478,761-board 5-token exhaustion) and proved the universal 4K fixed-overshoot cap impossibility bound in Lean 4.

Exhaustively verified 68,199,392 nonempty even-sum boards satisfying 3|S| > 2*max(S) + 1 through max <= 32 with zero exceptions (plus 8,921,362 boards containing [1, 8]), while refuting Brown-completeness alone in Lean 4 via {1,2,3,7,9,11,14,15,22}.
